title: Vinh Hiển Không Phai / Glory No Dey Fade
lyrics:
Verse 1
Từ sáng sớm cho đến tối I go sing
Vinh hiển của Chúa dey make me king
Không power of darkness fit resist
Niềm vui của Ngài dey always persist
Chorus
Vinh hiển không phai, Yesu reign forever
Quyền năng no dey shake, tình yêu Ngài fail never
Hãy nhảy múa và celebrate, chiến thắng everyday
Vinh hiển không phai, vinh hiển không phai
Verse 2
Lời chứng của tôi dey loud ngoài phố
Với Giê-xu, đời tôi complete o
Thiên sứ dey join bài ca melody
Heaven and earth dey sing in harmony
Chorus
Vinh hiển không phai, Yesu reign forever
Quyền năng no dey shake, tình yêu Ngài fail never
Hãy nhảy múa và celebrate, chiến thắng everyday
Vinh hiển không phai, vinh hiển không phai
Verse 3
Phép lạ dey follow every đường
Ơn phước dey fill hai bàn tay strong
When I shout lớn “Ha-lê-lu-gia eh!”
Enemies run scatter, dem fade away
Chorus
Vinh hiển không phai, Yesu reign forever
Quyền năng no dey shake, tình yêu Ngài fail never
Hãy nhảy múa và celebrate, chiến thắng everyday
Vinh hiển không phai, vinh hiển không phai
Verse 4
Mọi quốc gia go bow before King
Mọi ngôn ngữ go rise và sing
Forever Yesu, tôi hát praise
Saviour reign, quyền năng always
Chorus
Vinh hiển không phai, Yesu reign forever
Quyền năng no dey shake, tình yêu Ngài fail never
Hãy nhảy múa và celebrate, chiến thắng everyday
Vinh hiển không phai, vinh hiển không phai
english:
Verse 1
From early morning until night I will sing.
The Lord’s glory makes me a king.
No power of darkness can stand against it.
His joy endures.

Chorus
His glory never fades. Jesus reigns forever.
His power cannot be shaken. His love never fails.
Dance and celebrate victory every day.
His glory never fades. His glory never fades.

Verse 2
My testimony rings out in the street.
With Jesus my life is complete.
Angels join the melody.
Heaven and earth sing in harmony.

Chorus
His glory never fades. Jesus reigns forever.
His power cannot be shaken. His love never fails.
Dance and celebrate victory every day.
His glory never fades. His glory never fades.

Verse 3
Miracles follow me on every road.
Blessings fill both my strong hands.
When I shout aloud, “Hallelujah!”
My enemies scatter and fade away.

Chorus
His glory never fades. Jesus reigns forever.
His power cannot be shaken. His love never fails.
Dance and celebrate victory every day.
His glory never fades. His glory never fades.

Verse 4
Every nation will bow before the King.
Every tongue will rise in song.
Jesus, forever I will sing Your praise.
The Savior reigns, forever in power.

Chorus
His glory never fades. Jesus reigns forever.
His power cannot be shaken. His love never fails.
Dance and celebrate victory every day.
His glory never fades. His glory never fades.
description: From dawn to dusk, a singer carries the news of God’s unfading glory into the streets. Vietnamese and Nigerian Pidgin meet in a chorus that calls every nation to dance.

title: Victory Is Sure
lyrics:
Verse 1
मसीह में विजय है पक्की
उसने युद्ध जीत लिया
गाओ, बजाओ, ऊँची आवाज़ उठाओ
सारे मन से चिल्लाओ
Chorus
आवाज़: विजय
उत्तर: विजय
आवाज़: प्रभु में
उत्तर: प्रभु में
नाचो और उसकी स्तुति करो
सदैव सदा
Verse 2
हर परीक्षा बदलती है खुशी में
यीशु राह बना देता है
गाओ और चिल्लाओ, युद्ध हुआ खत्म
आज ही उत्सव मनाओ
Chorus
आवाज़: विजय
उत्तर: विजय
आवाज़: प्रभु में
उत्तर: प्रभु में
नाचो और उसकी स्तुति करो
सदैव सदा
Verse 3
अपना झंडा ऊँचा उठाओ
यीशु है राजा
उसमें हमारी विजय है
लोग सब गाएँ
Chorus
आवाज़: विजय
उत्तर: विजय
आवाज़: प्रभु में
उत्तर: प्रभु में
नाचो और उसकी स्तुति करो
सदैव सदा
english:
Verse 1
In Christ, victory is sure.
He has won the battle.
Sing, play your instruments, raise your voices.
Shout with all your heart.

Chorus
Leader: Victory!
Response: Victory!
Leader: In the Lord!
Response: In the Lord!
Dance and praise Him
forever and ever.

Verse 2
Every trial turns into joy.
Jesus makes a way.
Sing and shout! The battle is over.
Celebrate today.

Chorus
Leader: Victory!
Response: Victory!
Leader: In the Lord!
Response: In the Lord!
Dance and praise Him
forever and ever.

Verse 3
Raise your banner high.
Jesus is King.
In Him we have victory.
Let everyone sing.

Chorus
Leader: Victory!
Response: Victory!
Leader: In the Lord!
Response: In the Lord!
Dance and praise Him
forever and ever.
description: A Hindi call-and-response song about Christ’s victory. One voice calls out and the congregation answers before everyone joins in praise.

title: Ninainua Sauti Yangu / Lift My Voice
lyrics:
Verse 1
Nikikumbuka jinsi You don bring me far
Ninainua sauti yangu, I dance freely par
Rehema zako dey cover kichwa changu
Na nguvu zako dey raise me kutoka shimo
Chorus
Ninainua sauti yangu, I dance for Yesu
Ninainua mikono yangu, I shout haleluya
Ninainua wimbo wangu, I praise forever
Ninainua sauti yangu, ninainua sauti yangu
Verse 2
Nani fit kuzuia nuru ya Mungu wangu?
Who fit close njia ya Bwana wangu?
Sherehe dey fill moyo wangu kabisa
Na jubilation dey turn am to wimbo
Chorus
Ninainua sauti yangu, I dance for Yesu
Ninainua mikono yangu, I shout haleluya
Ninainua wimbo wangu, I praise forever
Ninainua sauti yangu, ninainua sauti yangu
Verse 3
When I praise, mbingu dey shake
When I dance, minyororo dey break
Popote I go, Roho Wako flow
Kila nafsi hupokea, joy go show
Chorus
Ninainua sauti yangu, I dance for Yesu
Ninainua mikono yangu, I shout haleluya
Ninainua wimbo wangu, I praise forever
Ninainua sauti yangu, ninainua sauti yangu
Verse 4
Mataifa yote go sing pamoja
Sauti za watu, both weak and stronger
Forever Yesu, Mfalme wa milele
Glory kwa Mungu, tena we sing
Chorus
Ninainua sauti yangu, I dance for Yesu
Ninainua mikono yangu, I shout haleluya
Ninainua wimbo wangu, I praise forever
Ninainua sauti yangu, ninainua sauti yangu
Chorus
Ninainua sauti yangu, I dance for Yesu
Ninainua mikono yangu, I shout haleluya
Ninainua wimbo wangu, I praise forever
Ninainua sauti yangu, ninainua sauti yangu
english:
Verse 1
When I remember how far You have brought me,
I lift my voice and dance freely.
Your mercy covers my head,
and Your strength lifts me out of the pit.

Chorus
I lift my voice and dance for Jesus.
I lift my hands and shout hallelujah.
I raise my song and praise You forever.
I lift my voice. I lift my voice.

Verse 2
Who can stop the light of my God?
Who can close the way of my Lord?
Celebration fills my whole heart,
and rejoicing turns it into a song.

Chorus
I lift my voice and dance for Jesus.
I lift my hands and shout hallelujah.
I raise my song and praise You forever.
I lift my voice. I lift my voice.

Verse 3
When I praise, the heavens shake.
When I dance, chains break.
Wherever I go, Your Spirit flows.
Every soul receives, and joy shines through.

Chorus
I lift my voice and dance for Jesus.
I lift my hands and shout hallelujah.
I raise my song and praise You forever.
I lift my voice. I lift my voice.

Verse 4
All nations will sing together.
Hear the voices of the weak and the strong.
Jesus forever, King everlasting!
Glory to God! Again we sing.

Chorus
I lift my voice and dance for Jesus.
I lift my hands and shout hallelujah.
I raise my song and praise You forever.
I lift my voice. I lift my voice.

Chorus
I lift my voice and dance for Jesus.
I lift my hands and shout hallelujah.
I raise my song and praise You forever.
I lift my voice. I lift my voice.
description: A singer remembers being lifted from the pit and answers with raised hands. Swahili and Nigerian Pidgin carry the invitation to sing together.

title: ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ / Yesu Meri Agg / Jesus My Fire
lyrics:
ਬੰਦ 1 (Verse 1)
ਜਿੱਥੇ ਵੀ ਜਾਵਾਂ ਤੇਰੀ ਰੋਸ਼ਨੀ ਚਮਕਦੀ
ਤੂੰ ਗ਼ਮ ਨੂੰ ਖੁਸ਼ੀ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਰਾਬ ਬਣਾਉਂਦਾ
ਜ਼ੰਜੀਰਾਂ ਟੁੱਟਦੀਆਂ ਜਦੋਂ ਮੈਂ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮ ਪੁਕਾਰਾਂ
ਤੇਰੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਲ ਹੈ, ਮੈਨੂੰ ਕੋਈ ਸ਼ਰਮ ਨਹੀਂ
ਰਿਫਰੈਨ (Chorus)
ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ, ਤੂੰ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਉੱਚਾ ਚੁੱਕਦਾ
ਮੇਰੀਆਂ ਸਿਫ਼ਤਾਂ ਫਟਦੀਆਂ, ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਖ਼ਾਹਿਸ਼
ਫਤਿਹ ਯਕੀਨੀ ਹੈ, ਮੇਰੀ ਖੁਸ਼ੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਥੱਕਦੀ
ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ, ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ
ਬੰਦ 2 (Verse 2)
ਤੂੰ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਤੂਫ਼ਾਨ ਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਲੰਘਾਉਂਦਾ
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਜ਼ਿੰਦਗੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਕਰਦਾ
ਹਨੇਰੇ ਤੋਂ ਕੀਮਤੀ ਰੌਸ਼ਨੀ ਵਿੱਚ
ਤੇਰੇ ਆਤਮਾ ਨਾਲ ਮੇਰਾ ਨੱਚ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਹੁੰਦਾ
ਰਿਫਰੈਨ (Chorus)
ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ, ਤੂੰ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਉੱਚਾ ਚੁੱਕਦਾ
ਮੇਰੀਆਂ ਸਿਫ਼ਤਾਂ ਫਟਦੀਆਂ, ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਖ਼ਾਹਿਸ਼
ਫਤਿਹ ਯਕੀਨੀ ਹੈ, ਮੇਰੀ ਖੁਸ਼ੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਥੱਕਦੀ
ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ, ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ
ਬੰਦ 3 (Verse 3)
ਬਰਕਤਾਂ ਹਰ ਰੋਜ਼ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਲ ਹਨ
ਤੇਰੀ ਰਹਿਮਤ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਢੱਕਦੀ ਹੈ
ਕੌਣ ਰੋਕ ਸਕਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਦਿਲ ਦਾ ਗੀਤ?
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਕਰਦਾ
ਰਿਫਰੈਨ (Chorus)
ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ, ਤੂੰ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਉੱਚਾ ਚੁੱਕਦਾ
ਮੇਰੀਆਂ ਸਿਫ਼ਤਾਂ ਫਟਦੀਆਂ, ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਖ਼ਾਹਿਸ਼
ਫਤਿਹ ਯਕੀਨੀ ਹੈ, ਮੇਰੀ ਖੁਸ਼ੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਥੱਕਦੀ
ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ, ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ
ਬੰਦ 4 (Verse 4)
ਸਾਰੇ ਰਾਸ਼ਟਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੀਤ ਸੁਣਣਗੇ
ਸਾਰੇ ਲੋਕ ਇਕੱਠੇ ਨੱਚਣਗੇ
ਹਮੇਸ਼ਾਂ ਯਿਸੂ ਨੂੰ ਗਾਵਾਂਗਾ
ਸਦੀਵੀ ਰਾਜਾ, ਤੂੰ ਸ਼ਾਨ ਨਾਲ ਰਾਜ ਕਰਦਾ
ਰਿਫਰੈਨ (Chorus)
ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ, ਤੂੰ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਉੱਚਾ ਚੁੱਕਦਾ
ਮੇਰੀਆਂ ਸਿਫ਼ਤਾਂ ਫਟਦੀਆਂ, ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਖ਼ਾਹਿਸ਼
ਫਤਿਹ ਯਕੀਨੀ ਹੈ, ਮੇਰੀ ਖੁਸ਼ੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਥੱਕਦੀ
ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ, ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ
english:
Verse 1
Wherever I go, Your light shines.
You turn sorrow into the wine of joy.
Chains break when I call Your name.
Your glory is with me. I feel no shame.

Chorus
Jesus, my fire, You lift me high.
My praises burst forth. You are my heart’s desire.
Victory is sure. My joy never grows weary.
Jesus, my fire. Jesus, my fire.

Verse 2
You lead me through the storm.
You make my life complete.
From darkness into precious light,
with Your Spirit my dance begins.

Chorus
Jesus, my fire, You lift me high.
My praises burst forth. You are my heart’s desire.
Victory is sure. My joy never grows weary.
Jesus, my fire. Jesus, my fire.

Verse 3
Blessings are with me every day.
Your mercy covers me.
Who can stop the song in my heart?
You bring my story to completion.

Chorus
Jesus, my fire, You lift me high.
My praises burst forth. You are my heart’s desire.
Victory is sure. My joy never grows weary.
Jesus, my fire. Jesus, my fire.

Verse 4
All nations will hear my song.
All peoples will dance together.
I will sing to Jesus forever.
Eternal King, You reign in splendor.

Chorus
Jesus, my fire, You lift me high.
My praises burst forth. You are my heart’s desire.
Victory is sure. My joy never grows weary.
Jesus, my fire. Jesus, my fire.
description: In this Punjabi worship song, sorrow becomes the wine of joy. The singer calls on Jesus through the storm and looks forward to the nations dancing together.

title: La Gloria No Se Acaba
lyrics:
Verso 1
Desde la mañana hasta la noche cantaré
La gloria de Dios me hace rey
Ningún poder de oscuridad puede resistir
El gozo del Señor nunca va a morir
Coro
La gloria no se acaba, Jesús reina por siempre
El poder no se mueve, Su amor nunca se pierde
Baila y celebra, victoria cada día
La gloria no se acaba, la gloria no se acaba
Verso 2
Mi testimonio se oye en la calle
Con Jesús mi vida nunca falla
Los ángeles cantan mi melodía
Cielo y tierra en armonía
Coro
La gloria no se acaba, Jesús reina por siempre
El poder no se mueve, Su amor nunca se pierde
Baila y celebra, victoria cada día
La gloria no se acaba, la gloria no se acaba
Verso 3
Milagros me siguen por donde voy
Cada bendición llena mi hoy
Cuando grito fuerte “¡Aleluya!”
Mis enemigos corren sin ayuda
Coro
La gloria no se acaba, Jesús reina por siempre
El poder no se mueve, Su amor nunca se pierde
Baila y celebra, victoria cada día
La gloria no se acaba, la gloria no se acaba
Verso 4
Cada nación se doblará al Rey
Cada lengua a cantar por Él
Por siempre y siempre Su alabanza doy
Nuestro Salvador, en Él yo estoy
Coro
La gloria no se acaba, Jesús reina por siempre
El poder no se mueve, Su amor nunca se pierde
Baila y celebra, victoria cada día
La gloria no se acaba, la gloria no se acaba
english:
Verse 1
From morning until night I will sing.
The glory of God makes me a king.
No power of darkness can withstand it.
The joy of the Lord will never die.

Chorus
The glory never ends. Jesus reigns forever.
His power stands firm. His love is never lost.
Dance and celebrate victory every day.
The glory never ends, the glory never ends.

Verse 2
My testimony is heard in the street.
With Jesus, my life never fails.
The angels sing my melody,
heaven and earth in harmony.

Chorus
The glory never ends. Jesus reigns forever.
His power stands firm. His love is never lost.
Dance and celebrate victory every day.
The glory never ends, the glory never ends.

Verse 3
Miracles follow me wherever I go.
Every blessing fills my day.
When I shout “Hallelujah!” out loud,
my enemies flee with no one to help them.

Chorus
The glory never ends. Jesus reigns forever.
His power stands firm. His love is never lost.
Dance and celebrate victory every day.
The glory never ends, the glory never ends.

Verse 4
Every nation will bow before the King.
Every tongue will sing for Him.
Forever and ever I give Him praise.
Our Savior—in Him I stand.

Chorus
The glory never ends. Jesus reigns forever.
His power stands firm. His love is never lost.
Dance and celebrate victory every day.
The glory never ends, the glory never ends.
description: From morning to night, a singer tells the streets of the joy of the Lord. A Spanish chorus invites everyone to dance and celebrate the reign of Jesus.

title: La Gloire Ne Disparaît Pas / Glory No Dey Fade
lyrics:
Verse 1
Du matin jusqu’au soir I go sing
La gloire de Dieu dey make me king
Aucun pouvoir de darkness fit resist
La joie du Seigneur dey always persist
Chorus
La gloire ne disparaît pas, Jésus reign forever
La puissance no dey shake, Son amour fail never
Danse et célèbre, victoire everyday
La gloire ne disparaît pas, la gloire ne disparaît pas
Verse 2
Mon témoignage dey loud for la rue
Avec Jésus ma vie dey toujours true
Les anges dey join ma mélodie
Heaven et la terre dey sing en harmonie
Chorus
La gloire ne disparaît pas, Jésus reign forever
La puissance no dey shake, Son amour fail never
Danse et célèbre, victoire everyday
La gloire ne disparaît pas, la gloire ne disparaît pas
Verse 3
Miracle dey follow chaque jour
Chaque bénédiction dey fill ma tour
Quand je crie fort “Alléluia eh!”
Ennemis run, dem scatter way
Chorus
La gloire ne disparaît pas, Jésus reign forever
La puissance no dey shake, Son amour fail never
Danse et célèbre, victoire everyday
La gloire ne disparaît pas, la gloire ne disparaît pas
Verse 4
Toutes nations go bow devant le Roi
Toutes langues go sing et give Him la voix
Forever Jésus, we go praise Tu nom
Notre Sauveur reign, forever strong
Chorus
La gloire ne disparaît pas, Jésus reign forever
La puissance no dey shake, Son amour fail never
Danse et célèbre, victoire everyday
La gloire ne disparaît pas, la gloire ne disparaît pas
La gloire ne disparaît pas, la gloire ne disparaît pas

His power is unshaken. His love never fails.
Dance and celebrate victory every day.
The glory never fades, the glory never fades.

My testimony rings out in the street.
With Jesus my life stays true.
The angels join my melody.
Heaven and earth sing in harmony.

Chorus
The glory never fades. Jesus reigns forever.
His power is unshaken. His love never fails.
Dance and celebrate victory every day.
The glory never fades, the glory never fades.

Miracles follow me each day.

my enemies run and scatter.

Chorus
The glory never fades. Jesus reigns forever.
His power is unshaken. His love never fails.
Dance and celebrate victory every day.
The glory never fades, the glory never fades.

Verse 4
All nations will bow before the King.
Every tongue will raise its voice to Him in song.
Jesus, we will praise Your name forever.
Our Savior reigns, forever strong.

Chorus
The glory never fades. Jesus reigns forever.
His power is unshaken. His love never fails.
Dance and celebrate victory every day.
The glory never fades, the glory never fades.
The glory never fades, the glory never fades.
description: A street testimony becomes a congregational refrain in French and Nigerian Pidgin. Heaven and earth join the singer in praising the Savior whose glory never fades.

title: Mama Dey Dance — My Turn to Lead (Afrojuju Disco Mix)
description: Mama teaches her child to dance in a bilingual gospel duet with conga, saxophone and disco bass.
lyrics:
[Instrumental intro – whistle motif, bass pickup, two handclaps]
[Verse 1 – Korean call, Nigerian Pidgin answer; equal bars for both voices]
해도 뜨기 전에 부엌에서 딱딱
Before day break, kitchen don dey sound, tak-tak
엄마가 나무 주걱으로 장단을 쳐요
Na Mama dey beat time with wooden spoon
슬리퍼 한 짝 벗겨져도 계속 돌아요

내 손을 잡고 웃어요, 너도 해 봐

title: Mama Dey Dance — Full-Length Celebration
description: Mama’s morning dance brings the neighbors together in praise.
lyrics:
[Intro – whistle pickup, bass and handclaps]
[Verse 1]
아직 골목엔 달빛이 남아
엄마는 맨발로 박자를 타요
낡은 마룻바닥 삐걱대면
그 소리마저 북이 되네요
어깨를 흔들고 내 손을 잡고
“우리 주님 좋으시지?” 웃으며 물어요
[Chorus 1 – call and response]
엄마의 춤, 오, 엄마의 춤
빙글빙글 돌아요, 손뼉을 쳐요
Mama dey dance! (We dey dance too!)
예수님 주신 기쁨 발끝에 차요
[Verse 2]
빗소리 세차던 어제 저녁
엄마도 말없이 눈물 닦았죠
오늘 그 두 손이 장단을 치니
문밖의 이웃도 따라 부르죠
드럼이 부르면 나팔이 대답해요
“누가 우릴 붙드셨나?” 예수님이죠!
[Chorus 2 – neighbours answer]
엄마의 춤, 오, 엄마의 춤
빙글빙글 돌아요, 함께 손뼉 쳐요
Mama dey dance! (We dey dance too!)
어제 울던 이 골목에 찬양이 차요
[Instrumental interlude – 8 bars, talking drum calls, bright brass answers, whistle leads back to the verse]
[Verse 3]
해 뜨는 담장에 그림자 둘
엄마의 발자국 내 발이 따라가요
한 걸음 비틀대도 괜찮아요
엄마는 웃으며 박자를 세죠
이제는 내가 먼저 손을 내밀어
“엄마, 한 번 더!” 온 동네가 웃죠
[Final Chorus – full choir]
엄마의 춤, 오, 엄마의 춤
빙글빙글 돌아요, 다 같이 춤춰요
Mama dey dance! (We dey dance too!)
대대로 이 기쁨 주님께 드려요
[Outro – strip back to handclaps, then voices alone]
엄마의 춤 (우리의 춤)
주님께 감사해요, 아멘
[Band resolves together on the home chord. Let brass and bass ring out fully. End.]
